Our government in Oforikrom.

Since January 2025, the NDC has been in government under President John Dramani Mahama. Locally, the Municipal Chief Executive leads the Oforikrom Municipal Assembly.

AS

Municipal Chief Executive, Oforikrom

Hon. Ahmed Anwel Sadat

Nominated by President John Dramani Mahama and confirmed by the Oforikrom Municipal Assembly in 2025.
